scenarios.title: Scoring: a normalizer joins the chain
scenarios.description: In the default order the evaluator first drops its direct model-client dependency and the result cache becomes a singleton, then the score normalizer arrives with its links.

scenarios.title: Scoring: normalizer first (custom order)
scenarios.description: The same change through the priority-order example comparator, which presents the step that adds the normalizer first: it arrives and wires in, and only then does the evaluator drop its direct link.

scenarios.title: Orders: pricing replaced, repository shared
scenarios.description: Legacy pricing leaves, the repository becomes a singleton and the controller gains a runtime clock lookup, then a price calculator and rate cache arrive. Shows keyed, stacked, collection and optional dependencies.

scenarios.title: Orders: new pricing first (custom order)
scenarios.description: The priority-order example comparator moves the step that adds the price calculator and rate cache to the front, so they arrive before legacy pricing leaves.

scenarios.title: NestJS: a gateway swapped, a logger shared
scenarios.description: Extracted by nestjs-di from its sample application. The payment gateway token is now satisfied by AdyenGateway, the transient audit logger becomes a singleton, and a notifications service arrives and is injected into the orders service. The controller is request-scoped because it injects a request-scoped context.

scenarios.title: Spring Boot: a gateway swapped, an audit log shared
scenarios.description: Extracted by spring-di from its sample application. The paymentGateway @Bean method now returns an AdyenGateway, the prototype audit log becomes a singleton, and a notification service arrives and is injected into the orders service. Shows a @Bean contract over its implementation, @Primary and @Qualifier clocks, a collection of validators and a request-scoped proxy.

scenarios.title: Orders: one revision
scenarios.description: The composition of a single revision, without a comparison.
